items.title: What is a magnet?
items.explanation: A magnet is an object that can attract certain materials, primarily iron and steel. In the story of Reshma, sailors used magnetic compasses to find directions at sea when stars were not visible.

items.title: How are magnets made?
items.explanation: Magnets can be made from naturally occurring lodestones or artificially by shaping pieces of iron. Modern magnets include various materials and shapes, such as bar magnets, U-shaped magnets, and ring magnets.
